title: Home Store Redemption Credit — Kessler Owner Rewards, Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Home store credit — Service Accounts and Repair Orders points redemptions.** The home store credit follows where the open repair order was written and the tier.

| Open repair order written at the account's home store | Account tier | Dollars added |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Platinum | 10.00 |
| Yes | Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 5.00 |
| No, or any other tier | — | nothing |

The open repair order is the repair order of the latest labor charge on the account, and the store that wrote it is the store on that charge. The account's home store is the store where the account was opened.
